items.title: Choose the article
items.rule: Use the article form with an article-bearing noun phrase; names, possessives and demonstratives require their own context. The ta'/tal- substitution is a useful diagnostic, not a rule based only on English the.

items.title: Sun consonants
items.rule: Before ċ, d, n, r, s, t, x, z and ż, the article l assimilates to the initial consonant. Compare fil-ħanut with fit-triq.

items.title: Vowel-initial words
items.rule: Forms differ by particle: ġol-ilma, mal-art, tal-ewwel and sal-artal retain l. Compare fl-art and bl-oġġett; do not use one universal vowel rule.

items.title: Shortened lil
items.rule: Choose article or no article first: lil becomes 'l or 'il; lill- becomes 'l- or 'il-. Retain i when the contraction lies between two consonant sounds. Keep a hyphen only with the article form.

items.title: Directions
items.rule: Learn direction phrases in context: ħares 'il fuq, mur 'l hemm. The h in hemm or hawn is not an ordinary pronounced consonant.

items.title: Two meanings of with
items.rule: Ma' expresses accompaniment; bi can express an instrument or manner. They are not interchangeable in every phrase.

items.maltese: Malli qomt dalgħodu fettili mmur dawra bil-mutur.
items.english: When I woke up this morning, I felt like going for a motorcycle ride.
I had not ridden it for years.

items.maltese: Kont xtrajtu meta kelli 18-il sena, għamilt sena nsuqu, u xħin xtrajt il-karozza, ma soqtux aktar.
items.english: I bought it when I was eighteen, rode it for a year, and stopped riding it when I bought a car.

items.maltese: Poġġejtu fil-garaxx ta' missieri u minn dakinhar insejtu.
items.english: I put it in my father's garage and forgot about it from then on.

items.maltese: Però dalgħodu tfajtlu l-petrol ġot-tank u malli pruvajt inqabbdu qabad mill-ewwel.
items.english: But this morning I put petrol in the tank, and when I tried to start it, it started immediately.

items.maltese: Iddeċidejt li nitlaq mix-Xewkija, fejn joqgħod missieri, għal Għajnsielem.
items.english: I decided to set off from Xewkija, where my father lives, for Għajnsielem.

items.maltese: Waqt li kont għaddej mit-triq, qasamli żiemel, evitajtu iżda ħbatt mal-ħajt tas-sejjieħ li hemm fil-ġenb tat-triq.
items.english: While I was going along the road, a horse crossed in front of me. I avoided it, but hit the rubble wall at the side of the road.

items.maltese: Waqajt għal tuli fl-art u stordejt.
items.english: I fell flat on the ground and felt dazed.
Someone stopped to help me.

items.maltese: Ħaduni l-isptar u żammewni jumejn għal osservazzjoni.
items.english: They took me to hospital and kept me there for two days for observation.

items.maltese: Nispera li d-darba li ġejja li mmur dawra ma jerġax jiġrili bħal din id-darba.
items.english: I hope the same thing does not happen the next time I go for a ride.
